s3/cp.rst.Example 13: To download an S3 object as: The command streams the S3 object's raw contents to standard output ('-'). The output is the arbitrary bytes of the object, not CLI JSON or a transfer status line, so it cannot be shown as an Output:: block, and saying it produces no output would be false.
